dataset.name: HYCOM Bay of Bengal — Water Temperature
dataset.documentation: Synthetic climatological Bay of Bengal water temperature fixture (lat: 2-26 N, lon: 58-100 E, depth: 0-4000 m). Variable: water_temp. Generated by backend/app/ingest/generate_fixtures.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: HYCOM Bay of Bengal — Salinity
dataset.documentation: Synthetic climatological Bay of Bengal salinity fixture (lat: 2-26 N, lon: 58-100 E, depth: 0-4000 m). Variable: salinity. Generated by backend/app/ingest/generate_fixtures.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: HYCOM GLBy0.08 Bay of Bengal — T / S / Currents
dataset.documentation: Combined multi-variable Bay of Bengal fixture (lat: 2-26 N, lon: 58-100 E, depth: 0-4000 m). Variables: water_temp, salinity, water_u, water_v. Generated by backend/app/ingest/generate_fixtures.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: HF-Radar Surface Currents (Demo)
dataset.documentation: Synthetic 2D surface-current vector field (u/v components) for the east-coast demo region. Variables: current_u, current_v. Generated by backend/app/ingest/generate_hf_radar_fixture.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: Copernicus Marine — Water Temperature (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: Live Copernicus Marine Service (cmems_mod_glo_phy_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m) potential temperature subset for Bay of Bengal. Variable: thetao. Fetched by backend/app/ingest/download_copernicus.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: Copernicus Marine — Salinity (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: Live Copernicus Marine Service (cmems_mod_glo_phy-so_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m) salinity subset for the India EEZ. Variable: so. Fetched by backend/app/ingest/download_copernicus.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: Copernicus Marine — Currents (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: Live Copernicus Marine Service (cmems_mod_glo_phy-cur_anfc_0.083deg_P1D-m) depth-resolved current subset for the India EEZ. Variables: uo, vo. Fetched by backend/app/ingest/download_copernicus.py. CF-1.8 compliant.

dataset.name: Copernicus Marine — Chlorophyll-a (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: Live Copernicus Marine biogeochemistry (cmems_mod_glo_bgc-pft_anfc_0.25deg_P1D-m) depth-resolved chlorophyll-a for the India EEZ. Variable: chl. Fetched by backend/app/ingest/download_copernicus.py.

dataset.name: INCOIS NIO-HOOFS — Surface Currents (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: INCOIS operational NIO-HOOFS surface-current forecast for the India EEZ, 3-hourly. Variables: uo, vo. Pulled from https://incois.gov.in/thredds/ and CF-normalised by backend/app/ingest/download_incois.py.

dataset.name: INCOIS — Sea Surface Temperature (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: INCOIS Ocean State Forecast SST for the India EEZ, 3-hourly. Variable: analysed_sst. Pulled from https://incois.gov.in/thredds/ by backend/app/ingest/download_incois.py.

dataset.name: Copernicus Marine — Ocean State (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: Copernicus Marine global analysis-forecast, India EEZ — temperature, salinity and currents merged into one file. Variables: thetao, so, uo, vo. 1/12°, 40 depth levels. Built by backend/app/ingest/download_copernicus.py.

dataset.name: INCOIS Ocean State Forecast (LIVE)
dataset.documentation: INCOIS NIO-HOOFS / Ocean State Forecast, India EEZ — SST and surface currents merged into one file. Variables: analysed_sst, uo, vo. 3-hourly. Built by backend/app/ingest/download_incois.py.
